status: partial implementation for the active 36-feature goal
behavior: A deterministic local trigger reads current selection, page, file, window or application context only for explicit, action-bearing foreground requests; generic this/that references and explicit read denials do not trigger capture.
Native and browser adapters return bounded current values; browser content is restricted to the exactly paired active tab and filters private/hidden content.

Raw references remain transient untrusted planner context; task persistence stores only a consumed marker, references expire after five minutes, and recovery does not inspect a replacement foreground item.
macOS and Windows activity views distinguish current-reference status from other events without displaying selected text.

No AI inference API, model, downloaded weights, new provider or dependency was added. Existing external planner destinations still require Sage data-release approval before receiving the exact request and context.
